title: Implement Claude Code discovery
description:
Implement discovery of Claude Code transcripts: ~/.claude/projects/<encoded-cwd>/<session-id>.jsonl where the encoded cwd replaces non-alphanumeric characters with dashes (over 200 chars: truncated plus a path hash — per the official docs); honor CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and configured archive roots; exclude subagent transcripts; attribute session and project from sessionId and cwd per record.

Done when: discovery finds synthetic fixture sessions under a fake home, decodes the project path, skips subagent files, and tolerates a missing root.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Implemented discovery in src/sentiment/adapters/claude-code.ts: ~/.claude/projects/<encoded-cwd>/<session>.jsonl walk honoring CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR (via claudeConfigDir/homeDir overrides) plus optional archive roots; excludes subagent transcripts (subagents directories and agent- prefixed files); missing root = absent source tracked in skipCounter.missingRoots, not an error; project path decoded best-effort from the encoded dir name with per-record cwd as the authoritative source. Tests: fixture discovery, subagent exclusion, missing root, decoding. Outcome: green.
